raw.details:
Organised by: IBM Db2 TechX
In Association With: IBM, Institution's Innovation Council (IIC), GL Bajaj Group of Institutions, Mathura, and NexaSphere
Opportunity Mode: Online
Participation: Individual (Solo Only)
Registration: Free
Submission Deadline: 10 November 2026, 5:00 PM IST

Results Announcement: 11 November 2026

About Db2Hack:

  • Ready to build something meaningful with AI and enterprise databases?
  • Db2Hack 2026 is an online hackathon that challenges participants to develop AI-powered applications using IBM Db2.
  • Build a practical AI use case by combining IBM Db2 with modern AI frameworks. Explore Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, vector search, document intelligence, and text-to-SQL applications.
  • The hackathon is open to everyone. You do not need prior experience with IBM Db2 to participate.
  • The goal is simple: learn, build, and demonstrate a working AI application on an enterprise database.

Challenge Tracks and Technologies

  • Participants must use at least ONE of the following supported frameworks:
    • LangChain
    • LlamaIndex
    • Haystack
    • CrewAI
    • Langflow
  • You can combine multiple frameworks if your project requires them.
  • Suggested project directions:
    • AI-powered RAG applications
    • Intelligent AI agents
    • Database-powered chatbots
    • Semantic search and vector search
    • Text-to-SQL applications
    • Document intelligence systems
    • AI-powered data analytics
  • You are encouraged to develop an original and practical use case.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to students, developers, freshers, working professionals, and AI enthusiasts.
  • Participants from any college, university, or organisation are welcome.
  • Individual participation only. Team submissions are not permitted.
  • Registration is free.
  • Prior IBM Db2 experience is not mandatory.

Participation Process

  • Follow these four steps:
    • Register on Unstop and complete your registration on Luma before 8 November 2026.
    • Join the official WhatsApp community. Joining is mandatory for updates, the Google Form, and workshop announcements.
    • Install the IBM Db2 Developer Extension for VS Code and set up your free Db2 Community Edition.
    • Build your AI application using at least one supported framework.

Submission Guidelines

  • Participants must complete BOTH submission requirements:
    • Create a Pull Request (PR) in the official GitHub submission repository.
    • Submit the PR link through the official Google Form.
  • Both submissions must be completed before 5:00 PM IST on 10 November 2026.
  • Participants must also share their project use case on LinkedIn and tag the organising team.
  • Incomplete submissions or submissions received after the deadline might not qualify for evaluation.

Rewards and Recognition

  • Top 3 Participants
    • Trophy
    • IBM Db2 Kit
    • Certificate of Excellence
  • Top 10 Participants
    • IBM Db2 Goodies
    • Certificate of Merit
  • Projects with High Potential
    • Opportunity to contribute your use case to the IBM Db2 GitHub Organisation.
  • All participants get an opportunity to showcase their skills through a practical project built on an enterprise database.

Workshops and Support

  • The on-campus IBM Db2 TechX Summit and hands-on workshop at GL Bajaj, Mathura, took place on 30 October 2026.
  • Additional online support includes:
    • Live online technical workshop.
    • Online doubt-solving session.
    • Guidance on Db2 setup, AI frameworks, and project submissions.
  • Dates for upcoming online sessions will be announced through the WhatsApp community.

Important Dates

  • Hackathon Started: 28 October 2026
  • Luma Registration Deadline: 8 November 2026
  • Final Submission Deadline: 10 November 2026, 5:00 PM IST
  • Results Announcement: 11 November 2026

Important Instructions

  • Individual participation only. No teams.
  • Registration on Luma is free.
  • Joining the official WhatsApp community is mandatory.
  • Use at least one supported AI framework.
  • Submit both your GitHub Pull Request and Google Form.
  • Follow the official submission guidelines.
  • All deadlines follow Indian Standard Time (IST).

Official Resources

  • Event Website: https://ibmdb2techxsummit.glbajajgroup.ac.in/
  • Registration: https://luma.com/68jmineh
  • WhatsApp Community: https://chat.whatsapp.com/L5EwLpFMmqa179MsOgi9fu
  • GitHub Submission Repository: https://github.com/KunalGolaIBM/IBM_Db2_TechX_Project_Submission
  • Resources and Tutorials: Available on the official event website.
    Build. Innovate. Submit. Make your AI idea work with IBM Db2.

See you at Db2Hack 2026!
